enabled.title: Turn on safe observation
enabled.description: Recommended first step. It flags matching public messages for review but cannot warn, delete, time out, or ban anyone.

enforcementEnabled.title: Allow Chat Guard to take automatic actions
enforcementEnabled.description: Leave off while learning and testing. Observation continues when this is off.

creatorApprovedEnforcement.title: Confirm that I want automatic moderation
creatorApprovedEnforcement.description: Required second safety switch. If it is off, Chat Guard remains observation-only.

enforcementMode.title: What should happen after a rule matches?

enforcementPlatforms.title: Platforms where automatic actions are allowed
enforcementPlatforms.description: Other selected platforms are still observed but no action is sent there.

enforcedRules.title: Rule matches allowed to cause an action
enforcedRules.description: Safe default: only a word or website you explicitly blocked can act. Other enabled checks remain reports only.

minimumRuleMatches.title: How many selected rules must match?
minimumRuleMatches.description: Keep at 1 for explicit blocked words or websites. Raise it only if you intentionally require multiple problems in one message.

warningMessage.title: Warning message
warningMessage.default: Please keep chat safe and follow the channel rules.

perUserEnforcementCooldownSeconds.title: Per-viewer enforcement cooldown (seconds)
perUserEnforcementCooldownSeconds.description: Prevents repeated actions against the same stable account during a message burst.

includeSimulated.title: Advanced: count simulated messages in reports
includeSimulated.description: Keep off for normal use. The rule tester works without this setting.

enabledPlatforms.title: Which chats should Chat Guard watch?
enabledPlatforms.description: Select every public chat that enters through your main THSV platform intake actions.

ignoredAccounts.title: Ignored platform accounts
ignoredAccounts.description: Preloaded with common service bots. Name rules use platform|name:login; stable-ID rules use platform|stable-user-id. Prefer !guardtrust for people you trust.

blockedTerms.title: Words or phrases you always want flagged
blockedTerms.description: Preloaded with high-confidence promotion spam. Enter one literal phrase per line; edit or remove any default. Matching ignores uppercase/lowercase.

blockedDomains.title: Websites you always want flagged
blockedDomains.description: Preloaded with common promotion-spam hosts. Enter only the hostname, one per line; edit or remove any default.

allowedDomains.title: Advanced: allow only these websites
allowedDomains.description: Leave empty unless you want every other linked website flagged. Enter only hostnames.

maximumCharacterRun.title: Allowed identical characters in a row
